### **1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE**

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- All styling lives in `style.css`. The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden — zero occurrences anywhere in the HTML.
- All design properties, layout rules, and states are targeted via class or ID selectors. Only a minimal baseline reset may target element selectors (`*`, `html`, `body`, `img { max-width: 100% }`).
- HTML must remain semantic and style-agnostic: restyling the site must never require markup edits.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
Define all tokens in `:root`. Light mode (default):

| Token | Value | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `--primary` | `#000000` | Primary action background (buttons, inverse blocks) |
| `--on-primary` | `#FEFEFE` | Text paired with `--primary` |
| `--secondary` | `#CC0000` | Alert red: danger, active borders, stamps |
| `--on-secondary` | `#FEFEFE` | Text paired with `--secondary` |
| `--bg-primary` | `#FEFEFE` | Page background |
| `--bg-secondary` | `#F2F2F2` | Card/panel background |
| `--bg-inverse` / `--on-inverse` | `#000000` / `#FEFEFE` | Final CTA & footer blocks |
| `--text-primary` / `--text-secondary` | `#000000` / `#36454F` | Body / secondary text |
| `--text-success` / `--text-error` | `#4B5320` / `#CC0000` | Military green / alert red |
| `--border-default` / `--border-error` / `--border-success` | `#000000` / `#CC0000` / `#4B5320` | Structural borders |
| `--accent-yellow` / `--accent-navy` / `--accent-orange` / `--lead-grey` | `#FFD700` / `#000080` / `#CC5500` / `#36454F` | Theme accents |
| `--shadow-color` | `#36454F` | Drives all hard shadows |

Theme-constant tokens: `--radius-sm: 0; --radius-md: 0; --radius-lg: 0` (zero radius is non-negotiable for this theme); `--border-width: 2px`; `--shadow-sm: 3px 3px 0 var(--shadow-color)`; `--shadow-md: 6px 6px 0 var(--shadow-color)` (never any blur); `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`; `--transition-fast: 80ms`; `--transition-normal: 150ms`; `--ease-standard: linear`; `--ease-snap: steps(2, jump-none)`; `--z-dropdown: 100`; `--z-modal: 200`; `--z-toast: 300`; `--font-base: 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif`; `--font-mono: 'Roboto Mono', monospace`.

- **Contrast pairing (mandatory, every theme):** every background token has a paired foreground token (`--on-*`). Never pair light-on-light or dark-on-dark. Caution Yellow always pairs with black text in both modes. Navy and Military Green are used only as block backgrounds with `#FEFEFE` text. Burnt Orange is reserved for large display accents (≥24px bold) — never small body text.
- **Exception (source spec vs. architecture):** the raw spec lists `background: #FFFFFF`; per the no-pure-white rule, bind `--bg-primary: #FEFEFE` — visually identical stark white, fully token-compliant.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- Define dark tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` AND as `.dark` / `.light` classes on `<html>` (class specificity must override the media query): `--primary: #FEFEFE` / `--on-primary: #0A0A0A` (buttons invert); `--bg-primary: #0A0A0A`; `--bg-secondary: #161616`; `--bg-inverse: #FEFEFE` / `--on-inverse: #0A0A0A`; `--text-primary: #FEFEFE`; `--text-secondary: #AEB6BC`; `--text-success: #9CAF88`; `--text-error: #FF5252`; `--border-default: #FEFEFE`; `--border-error: #FF5252`; `--border-success: #9CAF88`; `--shadow-color: #FEFEFE` (hard shadows flip to white). `--secondary` stays `#CC0000` (white-on-red contrast holds).
- **Theme switching:** background/text/shadow variables must flip with zero HTML restructuring.
- **Persistence:** store the choice in `localStorage` (key `theme`); on first visit fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`. `script.js` (deferred) always sets `.dark` or `.light` on `<html>` on execution so the class wins over the media query.
- **Toggle:** a visible header icon button (`.theme-toggle`) using Material Symbols `dark_mode` / `light_mode`, with correct `aria-pressed` state and an `aria-label` that updates ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode").
- **Exception (source spec vs. architecture):** the source spec marks dark mode as excluded (light-only); dark mode support is architecturally mandatory and is NOT dropped — implement it exactly as defined. Light mode remains the default presentation; dark mode is the inverted high-contrast variant.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build all layout structures with Flexbox (Tailwind flex utilities allowed). Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified with a CSS comment. Justified exception: the rigid equal-height column grids (Features, Steps, Pricing, Testimonials) may use `align-items: stretch` with children `flex: 1 1 0` and flush 2px shared borders between adjacent columns.
- Mobile-first: base styles are single-column; `min-width` breakpoints add columns. No horizontal scrolling at any viewport (test at 320px). Fluid type via `clamp()`. All images `max-width: 100%`.

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
- Use Tailwind CSS via CDN (`<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>` — an external reference, explicitly permitted alongside the single `script.js` entry point) for structural utilities only: flex, gap, padding, responsive prefixes.
- Every visual property (color, border, shadow, radius, typography) comes from `style.css` component classes bound to tokens: `.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.headline-bold`, `.article-block-border`, `.bw-image-accent`. Arbitrary color utilities (`bg-[#...]`, `text-[#...]`) are forbidden — colors exist only as tokens.

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- **Text:** Google Fonts `<link>` for **Roboto Condensed** (400;700;900) bound to `--font-base`, and **Roboto Mono** (400;700) bound to `--font-mono` (reserved for kickers, eyebrows, meta labels, stamps, footer colophon).
- **Uppercase voice:** `text-transform: uppercase` + tightened letter-spacing on all headings, buttons, nav, labels, kickers, card titles, stamps. Long-form body paragraphs and testimonial quotes stay normal-cased (400/700 weight) for legibility.
- **Icons:** Google **Material Symbols Sharp** via Google Fonts link. Forbidden: inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji as icons. Icon roles: feature icons, step markers, quote marks, pricing check/close, FAQ chevrons, modal close, theme toggle, toast status, form validation, empty states.

### **2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS**

**2.1 Button Component (`.btn`)**
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px; Roboto Condensed 700 uppercase; `border: 2px solid var(--border-default)`; sharp corners; `box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)`. Variants: `.btn-primary` (black bg / `--on-primary` text), `.btn-accent` (alert red bg / white text), `.btn-outline` (transparent bg, 2px black border), `.btn-danger` (red bg, white text, black border — visually distinct in BOTH themes).
- **Hover:** `translate(-1px, -1px)` with shadow growing to `5px 5px 0`; `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus-visible:** distinct ring — `outline: 3px solid var(--accent-yellow); outline-offset: 2px` — visible in both modes.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: translate(3px, 3px) scale(0.97)` with `box-shadow: 0 0 0` (the button "presses into" its shadow).
- **Loading (`.is-loading`):** `pointer-events: none` to block double-clicks; render a CSS square spinner (2px-bordered rotating square, `steps()` animation) or spinning Material Icon; lock `min-width` so dimensions never distort.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5; filter: grayscale(1); cursor: not-allowed;` no hover/active transforms.
- **Success/Error (`.is-success` / `.is-error`):** border, shadow, and text shift to `--text-success` / `--text-error` tokens plus a Material Icon — never color alone.

**2.2 Card Component (`.card` / `.article-block-border`)**
- **Default:** flex column; `border: 2px solid var(--border-default)`; `background: var(--bg-secondary)`; `box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm)`; zero radius; rigid equal-height grid placement.
- **Hover (interactive):** `transform: translateY(-2px)` + `box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)`.
- **Focus-within:** border color shifts to `var(--secondary)` when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (skeleton):** hard-edged grey shimmer blocks (zero radius, stripe/opacity pulse animation) that prevent layout jumps — used for the modal's simulated content load.
- **Empty state:** centered Material Icon + bold uppercase guidance text + optional action button.

**2.3 Form & Input (`.input-group`)**
- **Structure:** flex column wrapping `<label>`, `<input>`, and a dedicated, always-present error feedback container (`aria-live="polite"`, `aria-describedby` wiring, reserved space).
- **States:** empty; focused (3px yellow outline ring); filled; valid (`--border-success` + check icon); invalid (`--border-error` + error icon + `--text-error` message); disabled (opacity + greyscale + `not-allowed`); read-only (dashed 2px border). Input minimum height 44px, 2px border, sharp corners. Never rely on color alone — icon + text message always accompany validity states.

**2.4 Modal / Popup (`.modal`) — "Our Manifesto"**
- **Trigger:** the Hero's secondary CTA opens a manifesto dialog.
- **Structure:** fixed backdrop (`rgba(0,0,0,0.65)`, `z-index: var(--z-modal)`) as a flex container with `align-items: center; justify-content: center`; panel with 2px border, `box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--shadow-color)`, `background: var(--bg-primary)`, max-width ~40rem, sharp corners, Material Icon `close` button (44px target, top-right).
- **States:** opening (abrupt snap — `steps()` scale/translate, no soft fade), open, loading (skeleton lines ~500ms before revealing manifesto text), success/error (footer status line), closing (abrupt reverse).
- **UX:** `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby`; keyboard focus trap; close via `Esc` and overlay click; focus returns to the trigger; body scroll locked while open.

### **3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES**

- **Responsive by default:** fluid `clamp()` sizing, rigid grids stack to columns on mobile, zero horizontal overflow.
- **Abrupt motion language (mandatory transitions, tuned abrupt):** every state change has `transition: var(--transition-fast)` or `var(--transition-normal)` with `linear` / `steps()` easing — motion is snappy and mechanical, never a soft fade or long ease. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`: reduce → transitions to 0ms, decorative animations disabled, all content still accessible.
- **Text-highlight micro-interaction (`.hl`):** keywords inside headlines carry a persistent Caution Yellow marker highlight; on hover/focus the highlight snaps wider/re-inks (background-size or inset box-shadow technique with `--ease-snap`). Apply the same snap-marker hover effect to nav and inline links. The highlight is decorative only — never the sole carrier of meaning.
- **Abrupt section transitions:** anchor navigation jumps instantly (no smooth scroll) and flashes the target section (brief yellow background pulse class, removed after animation; skipped under reduced-motion). Scroll-reveal elements enter with an instant/stepped translate via IntersectionObserver (`.is-visible`), never a gentle fade-in.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for body text and ≥ 3:1 for large text in BOTH modes; never rely on color alone; semantic HTML5 landmarks (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section[aria-labelledby]`, `article`, `footer`); a single `h1` with logical heading order; ARIA on all custom widgets (accordion `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`, dialog, toggle `aria-pressed`, `aria-live` for form feedback and toasts); full keyboard operability with visible focus everywhere; meaningful `alt` text on every image.
- **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change — nav snap-underline, button press, card lift, accordion icon rotation + border flash, form loading → result, toast.
- **Toast (`.toast`, `z-index: var(--z-toast)`):** `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"` region, hard border + hard shadow, status Material Icon, auto-dismiss; used for newsletter and pricing CTA feedback.
- **Destructive actions:** `.btn-danger` is alert-red with white text and a black border — distinct in both light and dark themes.

### **5. PAGE STRUCTURE — SECTION-BY-SECTION REQUIREMENTS**

Build in order: Sticky Header → Hero → Features → How It Works → Testimonials → Pricing → FAQ → Final CTA → Footer. Every section: `aria-labelledby`, a mono kicker + uppercase `h2` section head, consistent vertical rhythm (`--spacing-gap` multiples), abrupt scroll-reveal.

**5.1 Sticky Header:** 2px bottom border, `--bg-primary` background, `--z-dropdown` stacking. Brand wordmark (900 weight, uppercase, red or black block behind it), anchor nav links, `.theme-toggle`, and a mobile menu button opening a full-width flex-column dropdown panel (2px border, hard shadow).

**5.2 Hero:** rigid 2-column flex (stacks on mobile). Left: mono red kicker (e.g., "INDEPENDENT POLITICAL & SOCIAL CRITIQUE — EST. 2026"); `h1.headline-bold` at `clamp(2.75rem, 9vw, 6.5rem)`, weight 900, uppercase, tight leading, with 1–2 `.hl` keywords; one-line subhead; CTA row (flex, wrap, gap): `.btn-primary` "READ THE LATEST" + `.btn-outline` "OUR MANIFESTO" (opens modal). Right: `.bw-image-accent` — picsum image with `filter: grayscale(100%) contrast(1.1)`, 2px black border, hard shadow, and a solid offset accent block (alert red) behind it that snaps on hover; plus a rotated `.badge-stamp` ("NO FILTERS.") — yellow bg, black border/text, `rotate(-3deg)`.

**5.3 Features — 3 cards:** rigid 3-column flex grid with flush 2px shared borders and equal heights. Each `.card.article-block-border`: Material Symbol in a bordered 44px+ square, uppercase title, 1–2 sentences of direct copy, and a "READ THE COLUMN →" link with snap-marker hover. Suggested icons: `gavel`, `campaign`, `visibility`. Hover lift; focus-within turns the border red.

**5.4 How It Works — 3 steps:** rigid 3 columns; oversized numerals `01 / 02 / 03` (weight 900, solid red or outlined via `-webkit-text-stroke`); step title + copy; a 2px rule visually connecting the steps; abrupt staggered reveal.

**5.5 Testimonials:** 3 `.testimonial.article-block-border` blocks: oversized `format_quote` Material Icon, quote in normal case (bold), author row with grayscale picsum avatar (56px square, 2px border), uppercase name, mono grey role. Highlight exactly one block with Caution Yellow background + black text (pairing enforced).

**5.6 Pricing — 3 tiers:** `.price-card` rigid grid. Plans: READER (Free), SUPPORTER ($5/mo — highlighted: yellow bg, thicker border, `--shadow-md`, rotated "MOST WANTED" stamp), INSTIGATOR ($12/mo). Each: plan name, 900-weight price, feature list with `check_circle` icons for included and `do_not_disturb_on` + strikethrough for excluded features, and a CTA (`.btn-outline` / `.btn-primary` / `.btn-outline`). CTA clicks must run the full button lifecycle: loading (~800ms) → success toast (honest demo copy, e.g., "DEMO: checkout isn't wired up. The revolution will not be charged.").

**5.7 FAQ:** 5–6 `.faq-item` accordions. `.faq-trigger` is a flex button (space-between): uppercase 700 question + `expand_more` icon rotating 180° abruptly. `.faq-panel` answer; `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls` / `role="region"` wiring; open item gets a 4px red left border; fully keyboard operable; abrupt open/close (no soft slide).

**5.8 Final CTA:** full-bleed inverse block using `--bg-inverse` / `--on-inverse` (black in light mode, white in dark mode — pairing enforced both ways). Giant uppercase statement with one `.hl` keyword; newsletter `.input-group` as an inline flex row (email input + `.btn-primary` "SUBSCRIBE"). JS validation exercises every input state: focus ring, invalid (red border + icon + inline message), loading, valid success (green border + toast "You're on the list. First dispatch soon."). All feedback announced via `aria-live`.

**5.9 Footer:** `--bg-inverse` background (token-adjusted per mode). Multi-column flex (wraps): brand + one-line mission; secondary links (About, Manifesto, Ethics & Corrections, Contact, RSS, Privacy, Terms); social icons as bordered 44px squares (Material Symbols: `mail`, `rss_feed`, `public`, etc.) with the button press effect; colophon line in mono ("© 2026 <BRAND>. All rights reserved. All opinions unfiltered."). Link colors maintain contrast in both themes; hover = yellow snap underline.
